observations.why: Adopting a new analytics pipeline names a move toward novelty, the appealed-to good of openness-to-change.
Quantified performance gain appeals to mastery and capability of the tool, the competence need.
Deferring migration to a named future quarter tempers change with scheduling stability, a conservation appeal.
Labeling the tool by its function frames the decision around capability fit, the competence need.
Restating the performance gain as improvement appeals to mastery and quality of craft.
Pinning migration to a specific quarter schedules change within a stable frame, a conservation appeal.
